text:
Maya (Sales): heads up - VelvetAI flagged a huge overage on their pilot invoice, asking for a one-time credit + Net45 for the remaining pilot invoices. Need quick ok.
Elaine (Finance): how big and reason?
Maya (Sales): Metering bug - internal project tags were mis-mapped to prod during a deploy window. Invoice INV-2025-0041 shows an overage of $27,300 that should not have occurred. Customer requests $27.3k credit and Net45 for the rest of pilot.
Hector (Acct Ops): commercial ask = 1) one-off credit $27,300 2) Net45 on pilot invoices only 3) signed addendum stating non-precedent 4) ops ticket for audit trail.
Elaine (Finance): $27.3k is above team auto-approve but below CFO manual escape? Need EM sign-off. Also need engineering confirmation of metering error and a ticket linking the root cause.
Maya (Sales): Eng confirmed the tag flip in deploy 2025-01-09, ticket RT-9123. I can attach logs. This is not a negotiated discount.
billing-bot: Billing alert: meter-mismatch detected on deploy DEP-2025-01-09. Related INV-2025-0041.
Elaine (Finance): ok. For accounting, book as "billing correction" GL 6207. Approver: Elaine (Finance) + EM. Legal to draft limited-term addendum.
Anya (Legal): will draft one-paragraph amendment: Net45 only for pilot, credit for metering error, explicit non-precedent clause. Will send to VelvetAI counsel.
Hector (Acct Ops): SF opp: 0098-VEL-PILOT. I'll create ticket TKT-5010 and note required approvals.
Maya (Sales): Sent draft to VelvetAI legal at 13:22.
Anya (Legal): VelvetAI signed and returned at 15:06. Uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood/pilot-velvetai/addendum-signed.pdf
Elaine (Finance): Received signed addendum. Approving one-off credit $27,300 booked GL 6207 as "billing correction - VelvetAI pilot". Applying Net45 for pilot only. Posting approval into TKT-5010 and notifying AR.
billing-bot: Refund processed REF-2025-122. Amount: $27,300 applied to INV-2025-0041. Status: pending settlement.
Maya (Sales): thanks all. i'll monitor pilot conversion and update opp.
Hector (Acct Ops): noted. adding clause ref to renewal docs to avoid accidental reuse.
Elaine (Finance): closing note: non-precedent, recorded in SF opp 0098-VEL-PILOT, GL 6207."
